chapter: First bands and brass band practice
title: Brass band repertoire: marches, funeral music and hymns
summary: Parker says brass bands played marches, funeral dirges and hymns, some from music and some by head.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Jazz funerals: dirges, hot return, second line

blocks.x: Now, what kind of marches and things would they play? Would they play 6-H marches, funeral dirges? Would they play blues, mizzou?
They'd play everything they're playing now. Played 6-H marches, funeral marches, four times. Everything that they got now, we have, we play that.
Would you ever play by ear in the band?
Oh, some things we... Some things, some old pieces we pick up, you know. Play by head.
What would they be? What kind of pieces would you play by head?
Would you ever play a hymn? A funeral? A hymn.
Oh, a hymn? Yes. Sure, man. Sing on, glory of the Lamb. When the saints go marching in. What a prayer we have in Jesus. Kneel over my garden to see that. All of them, yeah. Pray to all that.
And did you have music for that?
We had music for Sing On, Glory of the Lamb, and When the Saints. There you go. What a prayer we have in Jesus. Professor Shalom gave us that. And a friend that brought music.
